name: codex-mcp
description: CodeLocal native Go runtime and horizontally scalable MCP gateway for ChatGPT.

scripts.ci: npm run check:repo && go test ./... && go vet ./...
scripts.release:prepare: npm run ci && go run ./cmd/release && npm pack --dry-run ./.release/npm
scripts.release:npm: (npm whoami --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/ >/dev/null 2>&1 || npm login --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/) && npm whoami --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/ && bash ./release.sh
